key_insight: Agent evolution can stall because noisy evaluations fail to distinguish genuine improvements from harmful changes, not because better candidates are absent.
engineering_relevance: Self-improving agent pipelines should prioritize reliable evaluation and selection so real gains can accumulate.
method: Study seven evolution methods across six models.
Assess candidate-level selection of proposed artifacts.
Compare method rankings against independent-run variability.
evidence_signal: Across over 10 million LLM calls, candidate selection was no better than random at separating helpful from harmful artifacts, while typical method margins were smaller than differences between independent runs.
watch_item: Small reported gains need repeated-run validation before being treated as reliable improvements.
paper_title: The Resolution Hypothesis: Agent Evolution's Key Is Identifying Improvements
